Lakshmichand learns that the government has declared high currency notes as invalid. Goddess Lakshmi appears before Lakshmichand. He requests Goddess Lakshmi to give him gold in exchange of money. Lakshmi refuses to help Lakshmichand.
If you are trying to view this video from a location outside India, do note this video will be made available in your territory 48 hours after its upload time
